title: Prospective Manipulable-Architecture Coordinate Experiment, Age-on-Hit Semantic Intervention, Topology-Matched Indexing Counterfactual, Held-Out Law-Field Prediction & Descriptor-to-Causal-Morphism Identification

scope.support: inherit P26 frozen treatment-blind selected support; no P27 outcome-driven world reselection

manipulable_coordinate.name: probe_refreshes_age_on_hit
manipulable_coordinate.intervention: force hit-entry generation/age refresh OFF or ON while preserving key/depth/value/eval/move/bound/PV semantics
source_locality_gate: one audited age-field edit surface only
instrumentation identical across OFF and ON variants
native-equivalent policy must match clean baseline on a frozen deterministic preflight pack

history_instrument.reason: single fresh-process searches make hit-age refresh largely idempotent because entries are normally in the current generation
history_instrument.interpretation: history-conditioned law field; age effect includes mediated TT-survival/replacement consequences

held_out_prediction.prediction_object: three-bit fingerprint transition mask over curvature_class, dominant_coordinate, dominant_sign
held_out_prediction.consensus_rule: predict only state×square cells where both donors have the same OFF->ON transition mask
held_out_prediction.unresolved_rule: donor-disagreement cells are predeclared UNRESOLVED and excluded from agreement scoring
held_out_prediction.universal_morphism_gate: all 16 state×square cells donor-resolved and all 16 held-out masks exactly match

indexing_counterfactual.required_witness: dynamic frozen-key collision multigraph plus a bijective bucket relabeling preserving collision adjacency and occupancy opportunity
indexing_counterfactual.current_evidence: P26 has no dynamic TT-key/collision graph trace sufficient to establish this witness
indexing_counterfactual.forbidden: multiply-high<->low-bit-mask source swap presented as a one-coordinate intervention without the witness

lawgen_v3.principle: theory changes imply schema changes; schema compilation does not imply scientific truth

literature_constraints.constraint: mechanism transformations may be interventions, but the abstraction/intervention map must be explicit

literature_constraints.source: Grant et al. (ICLR 2026), Addressing divergent representations from causal interventions
literature_constraints.constraint: intervention validity and intervention-induced divergence are distinct from downstream agreement

literature_constraints.source: Sutter et al. (NeurIPS 2025), nonlinear representation dilemma
literature_constraints.constraint: low-capacity maps/predictions are part of the hypothesis; post-outcome alignment freedom is forbidden

prospective_claims.name: manipulability
prospective_claims.criterion: OFF and ON variants pass source-locality and native-equivalence gates before selective outcomes

prospective_claims.name: within_architecture_causal_law_effect
prospective_claims.criterion: report every state×square OFF->ON law-fingerprint transition separately for each architecture; no threshold retrofitting

prospective_claims.name: held_out_architecture_morphism
prospective_claims.criterion: freeze donor-consensus transition-mask predictions before any Ethereal P27 selective outcome is opened

prospective_claims.name: indexing_topology_counterfactual
prospective_claims.criterion: no indexing causal effect may be estimated unless the predeclared topology-isomorphism witness exists

claim_ceiling: P27 identifies only the age-on-hit coordinate within the frozen history instrument and 80k anchor budget; it does not yet transport that coordinate over the full P26 budget axis.
The history-conditioned effect includes mediated replacement/occupancy consequences and is not a pure instantaneous direct effect.
A held-out transition-mask match is evidence for a low-capacity causal morphism, not engine-independent ontological fundamentality.
Failure of the indexing witness is a manipulability hold, not evidence that indexing has no causal effect.
